title: McpAuthorization
description: A per-agent authorization that allows an external AI (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT with connectors, Gemini) to call Foco as an MCP server with a limited scope set. Defaults are conservative (§3.2 of UX_FROZEN). AI conversations inside Foco's own assistant are NEVER re-exposed via MCP (project_foco_mcp_bidireccional.md). Contract anchor: UX_FROZEN.md v1.3 §5.3 + §3.2.

agentId.description: Stable client identifier supplied by the agent, e.g. 'claude-desktop-local-8f3a'.

displayName.description: Human-friendly label shown in Settings → MCP (SCREEN 14). User can rename.

apiKeyHash.description: SHA-256 of the API key at rest. Plaintext is shown ONCE at creation and never stored.

apiKeyPreview.description: Last 4 chars, e.g. 'xY7q', for UI display. Never the full key.

scopes.description: Granular scopes per UX_FROZEN §3.2. 'learnings' is conservative default; 'socials' and 'github' require explicit opt-in.

revokedAt.description: If set, the authorization is revoked and future calls with this key fail-closed. Past audit entries remain immutable.
